errors.text: The hypothesis assigns embrittlement to percolation of B2 domains, whereas the target mechanism is enhanced L12 ordering within FCC domains coupled to jagged FCC/B2 phase boundaries.
It omits the key dislocation mechanism: increased antiphase-boundary energy and modulus suppress cross-slip, promote planar slip and pile-ups, and concentrate stress at jagged phase-boundary tips.
The proposed initial FCC matrix with discrete B2 precipitates does not reconstruct the as-cast FCC+B2 eutectic morphology.
It does not define the requested specific temperature boundary of below 550°C, 550–750°C, and above 750°C.
The cited evidence does not establish the requested prior evidence for restricted cross-slip or planar dislocation motion in highly ordered domains.
